# `grow-hashicorp-vault` (crate `grow_hashicorp_vault`) — agent quickstart (Rust)

Ships inside the crate (`~/.cargo/registry/src/*/grow-hashicorp-vault-X.Y.Z/AGENTS.md`). Docs:
https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/hashicorp-vault/ · Service: HashiCorp Vault · Categories: secrets.

```sh
cargo add grow-hashicorp-vault && cargo add tokio --features macros,rt-multi-thread
```

## Client

```rust
let client = grow_hashicorp_vault::VaultClient::new(grow_hashicorp_vault::VaultConfig::from_env()?)?;
client.close().await;
```

Errors: `grow_hashicorp_vault::Error` with `code()` (`ErrorCode::NotFound`, …). Credentials are `Secret`.

## Secrets: load the service configuration (one call)

```rust
use grow_hashicorp_vault::secrets::{load_config, LoadOptions};
let values = load_config(LoadOptions { required: vec!["DATABASE_URL".into()], ..Default::default() }).await?;
```

- `load_config(LoadOptions) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>>`; `LoadOptions { required, into_env (default
  true → std::env::set_var), keep_existing, path, env, connector }`.
- Bootstrap `GROW_SECRETS_PROVIDER` (must be `hashicorp-vault`), `GROW_SECRETS_ADDR`, `GROW_SECRETS_KV_MOUNT`,
  `GROW_SECRETS_PATH`, `GROW_SECRETS_AUTH=approle` + `GROW_SECRETS_ROLE_ID`/`_SECRET_ID`. Missing required keys →
  `NOT_FOUND`. No bootstrap or `GROW_SECRETS_LOADED=1` → only the required check.
- Also: `load_config_from`, `read_secrets_bootstrap`, `secrets_preloaded`.
